QUOTE: "The approval callback cannot veto. `on_tool_call` returns `void`. If it is registered, `check_approval` sets `approved = true` after calling it... The header comment at `permission_manager.h:6` says "default-deny", but that default only holds when no callback is registered."
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says a call passes when a callback is registered, but never concludes that a tool matching neither list runs by default. It leaves default-deny holding when no callback is registered.
